pyqgis_plugin.name: Chronicle Workbench
pyqgis_plugin.description: Move cemetery data between Chronicle databases, from one toolbar.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A toolbar for the mapping workflow: sync one Chronicle database's structure and reference data onto another, then upload, validate, preview and deploy. Everything it needs is inside it — add the tunnel under Settings ▸ Tunnel and the databases it should reach under Settings ▸ MySQL.
